I'm sorry you can't make it. All sales are final, so tickets aren't refunded if you can't attend. You'd only get a full refund if the event itself is cancelled.

What you can do is give your ticket to someone else. Just send them your QR code and they show it at the door. Each code only works once, so share it only with someone you trust and don't send it to anyone else.

If you want to ask about a refund for your situation, DM @socfrvr on Instagram.

If an event is cancelled, you get a full refund. With a combo pass, if one of its events is cancelled, you get a refund for that event. Otherwise all sales are final, so there's no refund if you just can't make it. For anything about a specific refund, DM @socfrvr on Instagram.

Since one of the nights was cancelled, you get a refund for that event. The other nights on your combo pass still count, and each one has its own QR code that works once at that event.

I can't process refunds myself. If the refund for the cancelled night hasn't come through or you have questions, DM @socfrvr on Instagram.
